title: Stonehenge Altar Stone as a lightning rod

tellings.quote: And then you have the alter stone of Stonehenge which was the lightning rod, the obelisk.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher of ancient sites, claims the Altar Stone at Stonehenge, the large stone at the centre of the ancient circle in England, worked as a lightning rod, much like an obelisk. He tells it to Michels as his own view, without naming a source. If true, it would mean the monument was built as a kind of machine rather than only as a temple.
